title: FID Kuwait – Official Handover Ceremony 2026–2028
summary: A significant occasion marking the official transition of the Forum of Indian Doctors Kuwait leadership for 2026–2028, including the reappointment of Dr. Susovana Sujit Nair as Vice-President for a second consecutive term.
description:
The Forum of Indian Doctors (FID) Kuwait held its Official Handover Ceremony on 2 October 2026 at Crowne Plaza, bringing together outgoing and incoming office bearers, executive committee members, past presidents and members of the medical fraternity.

The ceremony marked the formal transition from the 2024–2026 leadership team to the newly constituted committee for 2026–2028.

A particularly meaningful moment was the reappointment of Dr. Susovana Sujit Nair as Vice-President of the Forum of Indian Doctors (FID) Kuwait for the 2026–2028 term, marking the continuation of her leadership and service in the same capacity following her tenure during 2024–2026.

The occasion celebrated continuity in leadership, professional fellowship and a shared commitment to strengthening the Indian medical community in Kuwait.

title: A Distinguished Gathering in Honour of the Ambassador of India to Kuwait
organizer: M.M. Holding Company / Mughal Mahal Group
summary: A memorable welcome gathering hosted by M.M. Holding Company / Mughal Mahal Group in honour of H.E. Ms. Paramita Tripathi, Ambassador of India to Kuwait, and Mr. Pradyumn Kumar Tripathi, bringing together distinguished guests and members of the Indian community for warm interaction and fellowship.
description:
On 19 December 2025, the Executive Management, Partners and Family of M.M. Holding Company / Mughal Mahal Group hosted a special welcome breakfast and brunch in honour of H.E. Ms. Paramita Tripathi, Ambassador of India to Kuwait, and Mr. Pradyumn Kumar Tripathi.

The gathering brought together distinguished guests and members of the Indian community in an atmosphere of warmth, hospitality and mutual appreciation.

The occasion provided an opportunity for meaningful interaction with the Ambassador and fellow community members, including an address to the gathering that reflected the spirit of friendship, connection and shared community values.

A memorable occasion celebrating the importance of personal relationships, community engagement and the enduring bonds between India and Kuwait.
